summary.text: Randall Arrington is a Republican candidate for Louisiana's 1st Congressional District and a retired U.S. Navy aviator with a Ph.D. in political science. He describes careers as a naval aviator, federal law enforcement officer and university professor, and he ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Arrington was born in Corona, California, and graduated from Burbank High School. He earned a bachelor's degree from UCLA in 1976 and a Ph.D. from the University of New Orleans in 1999.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1976 to 1997; in his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a retired naval aviator who flew attack jets from four aircraft carriers.
Arrington describes careers as a pilot, federal law enforcement officer and university professor of political science; the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide lists him as a resident of Ponchatoula.
He ran for this seat as a Republican in 2024 and received 5.0% of the vote (17,856 votes); Steve Scalise won outright.
